summary.intent: Resolve todo #11: create the three missing VERIFICATION.md files for phases 18, 31, and 32, and close out the 'orphaned' PERF-01..04 requirements traceability gap so the v1.1 milestone audit can flip from gaps_found to passed.
summary.outcome: All three goal-backward VERIFICATION.md files were produced via a multi-agent workflow (gsd-verifier + adversarial skeptic per phase), amended to `passed` status based on maintainer sign-off, and committed on a docs/planning branch along with updated milestone audit, REQUIREMENTS.md, MILESTONE_SUMMARY, and TECH_DEBT docs.

repo: VERIFICATION.md files are phase-number-prefixed (e.g. 18-VERIFICATION.md), not generically named — searching for 'VERIFICATION.md' without a glob wildcard silently returns nothing.

REQUIREMENTS.md already had PERF-01..04 marked [x] and 66/66 mapped before this session; the 'orphaned' flag in the audit was solely about missing direct per-phase verification, not an actual requirements gap.

Phase 31 folder.service.ts was retired wholesale by PR #422 (2026-03-31) rather than decomposed into CRUD/metadata/publish as the phase specified; successor sdk-core/src/folder/index.ts is a 602-line monolith.
SharedFileBrowser.tsx grew to 946 lines after phase 31 decomposition — larger than the 943-line pre-split original; only row sub-components were extracted, no container/presentational split.

Kubo v0.34.0 does not expose libp2p peer/bandwidth metrics (libp2p_swarm_connections_*, libp2p_network_*_bytes_total emit No data); datastore size in Grafana comes from the app's own cipherbox_storage_bytes_total gauge, not the scraped Kubo endpoint — documented in the project's own staging baselines.
Milestone audit verdict (gaps_found vs passed) is driven by two counters: requirements mapped (62→66/66) and phases verified (17→20/20); both closed after producing the three reports.

code.finding: Registers cipherbox_ipfs_ipns_duration_seconds histogram with operation/result/source labels (PERF-01/02 wiring).
Records httpRequestDuration histogram on each HTTP response.
Globally registers http-metrics interceptor via APP_INTERCEPTOR provider.
Scrape block targets ipfs:5001/debug/metrics/prometheus with libp2p relabel filters — wiring is correct but Kubo v0.34 emits no libp2p metrics at that endpoint.
startTimer at :22, endBatchTimer at :49 with batchResult toggled to 'error' on failures (PERF-04 instrumentation).
PERF-01..04 already checked [x] with phase references before this session; only direct per-phase verification was missing.
Traceability table rows for PERF-01..04 already marked Complete at 66/66 total.

workflow: Pipeline workflow pattern (gsd-verifier agent → adversarial skeptic agent) is effective for producing and independently confirming goal-backward VERIFICATION.md reports without running test suites.
Never run full test suites concurrently from parallel subagents — they starve RAM; static-analysis-only verification is the correct mode for parallel agent verification work.
human_needed is the wrong bucket for upstream library limitations (e.g. Kubo not emitting metrics) — these should be recorded as accepted overrides with rationale, not queued for human action.
Branch protection rule in this repo: planning docs must never be committed directly to main/master; always use a docs/planning-YYYYMMDD branch (create or reuse).
The gsd `phase uat-passed` CLI exists in help output but has no handler; the workaround is to manually edit VERIFICATION.md + run `phase complete`.

friction: Initial glob command to find VERIFICATION.md files failed with a glob error, causing a false 'zero VERIFICATION.md files exist' conclusion that had to be corrected.
Terminology mismatch: todo used 'VERIFICATION.md' but the project also has VALIDATION.md files; required an extra investigation pass to confirm which naming convention was authoritative.
human_needed was the wrong status bucket for PERF-03 (a Kubo upstream limitation) — required a maintainer decision to reclassify as an accepted override rather than a pending human check.
Updating each VERIFICATION.md to passed required 6+ sequential Edit calls per file due to multiple sections needing independent edits (frontmatter, summary, status fields, override tables).
STATE.md's 'Pending Todos' section is narrative prose with a stale count — appending a completion note without rewriting the whole section required careful scoping to avoid a larger edit.
open_items: Todo #17: Large source-file refactor candidates — 26 files flagged; includes SharedFileBrowser.tsx (946 lines, SC2 deviation from phase 31) and sdk-core/src/folder/index.ts (602-line successor to retired folder.service.ts, SC3 deviation).
Phase 31 SC1: useSharedNavigationActions.ts is 579 lines against a ~400-line target — accepted as tech-debt but not yet split.

PERF-03 / Kubo v0.34 metric gap: libp2p peer count and bandwidth metrics are not emitted by the current Kubo version; Grafana panels are correctly wired but show No data — requires a Kubo upgrade to resolve.

16 remaining pending todos in the GSD system covering auth (ERC-1271, MFA), architecture (CRDT inbox, SDK consolidation), CI (pinning GitHub Actions SHAs), bugs (FUSE write-journal, IPNS subtree traversal), observability (logger redaction, Faro transport), and others.
